description: The effective network settings: each value, the fields an environment variable sets, and when a change takes effect

trusted_ips.description: IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges whose X-Forwarded-For / PROXY protocol address is trusted (env TRUST_IP)

trust_cloudflare.description: Trust the Cloudflare IP ranges (env TRUST_CLOUDFLARE)

locked.description: Fields that cannot be changed because an environment variable sets them, or forces them (see locked_by and locked_reason). A save ignores them (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the environment variable that sets it. A field locked by its own variable names that variable; a field another setting forces names the variable of that setting (read only)

trusted_ips.description: Name of the variable that locks the trusted ips: TRUST_IP

trust_cloudflare.description: Name of the variable that locks the trust cloudflare: TRUST_CLOUDFLARE

locked_reason.description: Always empty: no field of this section is locked by the variable of another setting

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect

trusted_ips.description: When a change of the trusted ips takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

trust_cloudflare.description: When a change of the trust cloudflare takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

restart_pending.description: Always empty: every network setting applies without a container restart
